## Checklist

- [ ] The change matches the approved spec and one focused plan task.
- [ ] Tests were written first and the red/green sequence is recorded.
- [ ] Lint, type checks, and relevant offline tests pass.
- [ ] No credential, secret-bearing log, or machine-local path is committed.
- [ ] Documentation and `AGENT_LOG.md` are updated where behavior or decisions changed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots; non-UI changes mark this item not applicable.
